199336 is a scripted dummy spell; its 204831 response is also a dummy aura, not charm. The SmartAI sequence never changed Beshtal's faction.

Council template faction 2757 is neutral to player factions. Native faction 2501 differs only by FriendGroup=1; it retains faction 959 and enemy 960. This prevents friendly-player retaliation while preserving combat against Beshtal.

Use player-friendly native faction 2501 for prison council 98771/98775/98783/98793.

Beshtal becomes faction 35 during cage opening, restores his original 2102 at the escape warning, attacks and signals freed Ritssyn to fight him. This is temporary scripted control, not a permanent demon pet.
